title: Continuous media playout and business scenes
summary: Single ongoing WebM working stream at 1280x720, 24 fps with 48 kHz audio is the current test target. The original Google-generated masters remain source media; the resident playout service switches predecoded agent states and authorised information scenes.
invariants: Keep the virtual camera and audio endpoints open while scenes change.
Prefer WebM VP8/VP9 and source FPS for working footage; do not needlessly transcode short source media to H.264/OpenH264.
Speech, business information and onscreen scene are separate plan components.
An invoice or TPS report view is rendered from a permitted business object, never invented by an LLM.
A cartoon cat can reuse a very small motion-state library; photorealistic human-level lip movement is not mandatory for this presenter.
procedure: Idle/listening → short stock speech → authorised business display → return to agent.
Keep source audiovisual clocks aligned even when the speaking agent is off-screen.
For new scenes, retain provenance, review status and usage scope.

provenance.claim: Readback six-utterance generation plan, script matching and review limits.
FFmpeg PTS range tracking and checkpoint interface, with MediaPipe not runtime-qualified.
